Class EmailSend

java.lang.Object
utils.EmailSend
public class EmailSend extends Object
Utility class for sending email and SMS notifications. Handles JavaMail sessions, asynchronous sending, and message content generation for various scenarios (reservations, reminders, bills, etc.).
